DeprecationNotice.description: A structured deprecation declaration attached to a public surface.
DeprecationNotice.title: Deprecation Notice

ServiceConfigInput.description: Accepted Landofile service authoring surface with canonical keys and the working_dir, env_file, and depends_on Compose aliases.

allowOverride.description: Whether an Apache-backed service enables .htaccess overrides for its webroot.

cap_add.description: Linux capabilities to add as a single Compose capability or capability list; canonicalized to a string list.

cap_drop.description: Linux capabilities to drop as a single Compose capability or capability list; canonicalized to a string list.

configs.description: Service config grants as source-name strings or long entries; canonicalized to long entries, carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

depends_on.description: Compose alias for the canonical dependsOn service field; accepts a service-name list or condition map.

deploy.description: Deployment resources as null or a limits and reservations object; canonicalized to resources-only data with memory in bytes and device options as maps, while Swarm orchestration keys are rejected.

devices.description: Device mappings as source:target[:permissions] strings or long source, target, and permissions objects; canonicalized to a list of long objects.

dns.description: Custom DNS servers as a single address or address list; canonicalized to a string list.

dns_opt.description: Resolver options as a single Compose option or option list; canonicalized to a string list.

dns_search.description: DNS search domains as a single domain or domain list; canonicalized to a string list.

publication.description: Explicit host-publication intent and policy overrides.

env_file.description: Compose alias for the canonical envFile service field; accepts one path or a path list.

extra_hosts.description: Additional host mappings as a hostname-to-address map or HOST=IP and HOST:IP list; canonicalized to a hostname map.

gpus.description: GPU access as the Compose literal "all" or a device-request list; canonical output preserves "all" or uses device objects with options canonicalized to maps.

group_add.description: Supplementary groups as one string or number, or as a list of either; canonicalized to a group list while preserving each value.

init.description: Whether an init process forwards signals and reaps child processes in the container.

logging.description: Container logging driver and driver-specific scalar options.

path.description: Single absolute in-container file path declared under `services.<name>.logs`.

networks.description: Service network attachments as a name list or long mapping; canonicalized to a long mapping and carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

platform.description: Target runtime platform in operating-system and architecture form.

privileged.description: Whether the container runs with extended host privileges.

profiles.description: Compose profile names; carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

pull_policy.description: Upstream Compose policy controlling when the service image is pulled.

read_only.description: Whether the container root filesystem is mounted read-only.

restart.description: Container restart policy: no, always, on-failure, or unless-stopped.

secrets.description: Service secret grants as source-name strings or long entries; canonicalized to long entries, carried losslessly into ServicePlan.extensions.compose and capability-checked; no Lando-side activation.

security_opt.description: Container security options as a single Compose option or option list; canonicalized to a string list.

shm_size.description: Shared-memory size as integer bytes or a Compose byte-size string; canonicalized to integer bytes.

stop_grace_period.description: Graceful-stop period as a Compose duration string or canonical numeric seconds; canonicalized to seconds.

stop_signal.description: Signal used to request graceful container shutdown, such as SIGTERM.

sysctls.description: Kernel parameters as a Compose scalar map or KEY=value list; canonicalized to a scalar map.

tmpfs.description: Temporary filesystem mounts as a single Compose mount string or string list; canonicalized to a string list.

ulimits.description: Process limits as integer or string scalars, or explicit soft and hard objects; canonicalized to a map of soft and hard limit objects.

webroot.description: Container path served as this service's HTTP document root.

working_dir.description: Compose alias for the canonical workingDirectory service field.

ServiceConfigInput.title: Service Config Input

ServiceDependency.description: A single inter-service dependency with its optional Compose condition, required, and restart flags.
ServiceDependency.title: Service Dependency

ServiceDependencyCondition.description: How a service dependency must be satisfied before dependents start: on process start, on healthcheck success, or on successful completion.
ServiceDependencyCondition.title: Service Dependency Condition

aliases.description: kind: "tooling" only — additional namespaces the included tasks also register under.

excludes.description: kind: "tooling" only — fragment task names dropped before flattening or namespace registration.

flatten.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, included task names register unprefixed instead of under the include namespace.

internal.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, every task contributed by this include is hidden.

kind.description: The fragment content semantics: "landofile" is a Landofile fragment; "compose" is a Compose fragment routed through the same parser, rejection, and decode path; "tooling" is a tooling fragment carrying only tooling: and toolingIncludes:. This is not source transport.

namespace.description: kind: "tooling" only — the sub-namespace included tasks register under. Required unless flatten is true.

optional.description: kind: "tooling" only — when true, a missing fragment file is skipped instead of failing.

vars.description: kind: "tooling" only — literal vars applied to every included task unless the task defines its own value.

lando.description: Semver range the running Lando core version must satisfy before the app is planned or started (e.g. ">=4.1 <5"). Prereleases are included; unsatisfied constraints fail closed with remediation.

arguments.description: Set to false to reject caller-supplied positional arguments for this task.

aliases.description: Additional namespaces the included tasks also register under.

excludes.description: Fragment task names dropped before flattening or namespace registration.

file.description: Path to the tooling fragment, resolved relative to the file that declares the include and contained under the app root.

flatten.description: When true, included task names register unprefixed instead of under the include namespace.

internal.description: When true, every task contributed by this include is registered hidden.

optional.description: When true, a missing fragment file is skipped instead of failing the load.

vars.description: Literal vars applied to every included task unless the task defines its own value.

toolingIncludes.description: Shorthand map of tooling-fragment includes keyed by include namespace; equivalent to includes: entries with kind: tooling.
